title: Run Clarity cookieless for every visitor: consentV2 denied in code AND the project's Cookies setting OFF
body: Decided by the author 2026-10-29 for EU visitors: no consent banner, no geolocation, Clarity records for everyone without cookies. Two pieces, both required. (1) src/scripts/analytics.ts calls Clarity.consentV2({ ad_Storage: 'denied', analytics_Storage: 'denied' }) right after Clarity.init: no first-party cookies (_clck, _clsk), and /collect still records. (2) The Clarity project setting Settings > Setup > Advanced > Cookies is OFF. Measured on production 2026-10-30 (Playwright Chromium, fresh context): with (1) alone, the tag and its c.gif sync pixels still set third-party cookies (CLID, MUID, MR, SM, ANONCHK on clarity.ms; MUID, MR, SRM_B on bing.com), and queuing the consent before the tag or using consent(false) changed nothing. With the setting OFF: zero cookies anywhere, /collect still records. The footer privacy line (footerPrivacy* in content/schema/messages.ts) says 'sin cookies'; keep it true: do not turn the setting back on, connect Microsoft Ads, or flip consent to granted without the author. To re-verify: load / in a fresh browser, scroll, wait ~10 s, list every cookie in the context (not only document.cookie).
not_derivable: The Clarity dashboard setting lives outside the repo, and the code comment alone suggests consentV2 is sufficient; only a production measurement showed the third-party cookies.

evidence.summary: Cited when this memory was saved.

2026-10-30 production check: with consentV2 denied only, 8 third-party cookies on clarity.ms and bing.com; after the author turned Cookies OFF in Clarity's project settings, none, with /collect still recording.
